notes: Synthetic contract examples, not execution evidence or completed AI calls.
Each scenario declares an independent stateId and nextStateId; reset state between unrelated scenarios.

Same-company role switches may replace actor after authorization. Cross-company switches must select a complete matching Workspace snapshot and clear all prior-company state; changing only actor is forbidden.
Binary fixture metadata is illustrative; no receipt image bytes are generated in STEP-1. getReceiptImage success will be exercised once #21 supplies images.
JSON responses are complete DTO envelopes. Multipart fixtures use a transport descriptor, never a fake Blob JSON value.

Successful state-changing write scenarios append audit events and inherit the declared preceding state's log. Duplicate/replayed no-op requests do not create a second business event. Error fixtures preserve business state; rejected-attempt audit telemetry may be appended by the implementation.
